```{r packages & wd, include=FALSE}
# Locate 4-analysis/ regardless of R's working directory. here::here() walks up from getwd() to the
# .here marker in 4-analysis/, so if R was started elsewhere (e.g. your home folder) first move into
# this file's folder (works from RStudio and VS Code; needs the rstudioapi package).
local({
  if (!file.exists(".here") && !file.exists("../.here")) {
    p <- tryCatch(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path, error = function(e) "")
    if (nzchar(p)) setwd(dirname(p))
  }
  here::i_am("scripts/01_cleaning.Rmd")
})

setwd(here::here())


#clean data loading - original dfs were loaded into R via qualtRics package & identifiers were dropped, then saved as 1 RData file (including study 1 & study 2 dfs in both numeric & text format)
# Prefer de-identified shareable version if present, otherwise fall back to raw
raw_file <- if (file.exists(here::here("data", "raw", "original_dfs_shareable.RData"))) {
  here::here("data", "raw", "original_dfs_shareable.RData")
} else {
  here::here("data", "raw", "original_dfs.RData")
}
load(raw_file)
```

```{r cleaning - drop irrel columns &  join text & numeric dfs}

#merging study 1 & study 2 dfs for text & numeric 
df$Age <- as.character(df$Age)
df_s2$Age <- as.character(df_s2$Age)

df$screenquality <- as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", df$screenquality))
df_s2$screenquality <- as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", df_s2$screenquality))

df_trim <- bind_rows(df,df_s2)
df_text2 <- bind_rows(df_text,df_text_s2)

df_text2 <- df_text2 %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(ResponseId,Race_1:VoteMethod)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-(c(Gender,religion,nicks,PartyAffil_4_TEXT,PartyReg_4_TEXT)))

df_trim$ResponseId <- as.character(df_trim$ResponseId)
df_text2$ResponseId <- as.character(df_text2$ResponseId)


df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df_text2, by = "ResponseId", suffix = c("", ".text")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-(c(Status:IPAddress,rid,NewsSources_2:NewsSources_27,`__js_chatPartialData`,
                    Q_RecaptchaScore,Misinformation_Resis:projectId,controlType)))


#creating adl screener vars - if they selected the 2 responses they should have
```

```{r formatting conditions}

#cleaning condition vars
table(df_trim$messageType)

df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  mutate(messageTypeOG = messageType,
         
         messageType = if_else(startsWith(ChatbotPromptTemplate, "Your goal is to tell users to stop believing that the 2020 US Election was rigged/fraudulent") & messageType == "Chat_CtrlCatsDogs","Chat_Ctrl",messageType), #survey flow error? some people in cats & dogs received limited feedback prompt instead so categorizing based on prompt instead for that subset
         
         Condition = if_else(messageType == "Control" | messageType == "Chat_Ctrl" | messageType == "Chat_CtrlCatsDogs", 0,
                             if_else(is.na(messageType),NA,1)), #feedback-based treatment vs the 2 control conditions (cats & dogs + adversarial dialogue)
         
         ConditionCatsDogs = if_else(messageType == "Chat_CtrlCatsDogs", 0,
                                     if_else(is.na(messageType),NA,1)),
         
         ConditionAdvers = if_else(messageType == "Control" | messageType == "Chat_Ctrl", "Adversarial Dialogue",
                                    if_else(messageType == "Chat_CtrlCatsDogs", "Control",
                                            if_else(is.na(messageType),NA,"Belief-Tailored"))))


df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  mutate(messageType = if_else(messageType == "Active", "Qualtrics + Belief-Tailored",
                               if_else(messageType == "Control", "Qualtrics  + Adversarial Dialogue",
                                       if_else(messageType == "Personalized", "Qualtrics + Belief & Values-Tailored",
                                               
                                               if_else(messageType == "Chat_Act" | messageType == "Chat", "Chat + Belief-Tailored",
                                                       if_else(messageType == "Chat_Ctrl", "Chat + Adversarial Dialogue",
                                                               if_else(messageType == "Chat_Persnalized" | messageType == "Personalized-Chat", "Chat + Belief & Values-Tailored",
                                                                       if_else(messageType == "Chat_CtrlCatsDogs", "Chat + Control", messageType)))))))) %>%
  
  
  mutate(ConditionChat = if_else(str_detect(messageType, "Chat"), "Chat",
                                 if_else(str_detect(messageType, "Qualtrics"), "Qualtrics",
                                         if_else(is.na(messageType),NA,NA))),
         
         ConditionFeedback = if_else(messageType == "Qualtrics + Belief-Tailored" | messageType == "Chat + Belief-Tailored", "Belief-Tailored",
                                     if_else(str_detect(messageType, "Values"), "Belief & Values-Tailored",
                                             if_else(str_detect(messageType, "Adversarial"), "Adversarial Dialogue",
                                                     if_else(str_detect(messageType, "CatsDogs") | messageType == "Chat + Control", "Control",
                                                             if_else(is.na(messageType),NA,""))))),
         
         #study variable
         Study = if_else(StartDate >= "2024-10-03" & DistributionChannel != "preview",2,
                         if_else(StartDate >= "2024-07-31" & StartDate < "2024-10-01" & DistributionChannel != "preview",1,
                                 if_else(StartDate >= "2024-07-20" & StartDate < "2024-07-30" & DistributionChannel != "preview",0,NA)))) %>%
  
  mutate(ConditionPers = as.numeric(if_else(ConditionFeedback == "Belief & Values-Tailored", 1, 0, missing = NA)),
         ConditionDet = as.numeric(if_else(ConditionFeedback == "Belief-Tailored", 1, 0, missing = NA)),
         ConditionLim = as.numeric(if_else(ConditionFeedback == "Adversarial Dialogue", 1, 0, missing = NA)))
  

#Making condition vars factor
df_trim$messageType <- factor(df_trim$messageType,
                              levels = c("Qualtrics  + Adversarial Dialogue","Qualtrics + Belief-Tailored","Qualtrics + Belief & Values-Tailored",
                                         "Chat + Adversarial Dialogue","Chat + Control","Chat + Belief-Tailored","Chat","Chat + Belief & Values-Tailored", "Personalized-Chat"))

df_trim$ConditionFeedback <- factor(df_trim$ConditionFeedback,
                              levels = c("Control","Adversarial Dialogue","Belief & Values-Tailored","Belief-Tailored"))

df_trim$ConditionChat <- factor(df_trim$ConditionChat,
                              levels = c("Qualtrics","Chat"))

df_trim$Condition <- factor(df_trim$Condition, levels = c(0,1))
table(df_trim$Condition)


df_trim$ConditionFeedback.z <- as.numeric(factor(df_trim$ConditionFeedback,
                              levels = c("Control","Adversarial Dialogue","Belief & Values-Tailored","Belief-Tailored"),
                              labels = c(1,2,3,4)))

df_trim$ConditionChat.z <- as.numeric(factor(df_trim$ConditionChat,
                              levels = c("Qualtrics","Chat"),
                              labels = c(0,1)))


df_trim$ConditionFeedback.z <- scale(df_trim$ConditionFeedback.z)
df_trim$ConditionChat.z <- scale(df_trim$ConditionChat.z)


table(df_trim$messageTypeOG)
table(df_trim$messageType)
table(df_trim$ConditionChat,useNA = 'always')
table(df_trim$ConditionFeedback,useNA = 'always')
table(df_trim$Study,useNA = 'always')


```

# Variable Creation
```{r dvs}

#election rigged adl vars----
df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("ElecRigged"), as.numeric)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-(ElecRigged_Pre)) #doubled var 

df_trim %>%
  select((starts_with("ElecRigged"))) %>%
  names()

#reverse code ER2, last 2 items, pre & post
summary(df_trim$ElecRigged_2_Pre_2)
df_trim[ , c("ElecRigged_2_Pre_2","ElecRigged_2_Pre_3","ElecRigged_2_Post_2","ElecRigged_2_Post_3")] = 6 - df_trim[ ,c("ElecRigged_2_Pre_2","ElecRigged_2_Pre_3","ElecRigged_2_Post_2","ElecRigged_2_Post_3")]

summary(df_trim$ElecRigged_2_Pre_2)

df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  #means for each scale
                dplyr::rowwise() %>%
                 mutate(ER1_Pre = mean(c_across(starts_with("ElecRigged_1_Pre")), na.rm = TRUE),
                        ER2_Pre = mean(c_across(starts_with("ElecRigged_2_Pre")), na.rm = TRUE),
                        
                        ER1_Post = mean(c_across(starts_with("ElecRigged_1_Post")), na.rm = TRUE),
                        ER2_Post = mean(c_across(starts_with("ElecRigged_2_Post")), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%

  #normalize to 0-100 scale #min-max normalization [New value = (value – min) / (max – min)]
  dplyr::mutate(ER1Norm_Pre = ((ER1_Pre-1)/3) * 100, #1-4 scale
                ER2Norm_Pre = ((ER2_Pre-1)/4) * 100, #1-5 scale 

                ER1Norm_Post = ((ER1_Post-1)/3) * 100, #1-4 scale
                ER2Norm_Post = ((ER2_Post-1)/4) * 100) %>% #1-5 scale
  
  #means again
  dplyr::mutate(ER_Pre = mean(c_across(matches("ER\\d+Norm_Pre")), na.rm = TRUE),
                ER_Post = mean(c_across(matches("ER\\d+Norm_Post")), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  dplyr::rename(ER0Norm_Pre = ElecRigged_Pre_1, #0-100 scale
                ER0Norm_Post = ElecRigged_Post_1) %>% #0-100 scale
  
  dplyr::mutate(ER0_Diff = ER0Norm_Post - ER0Norm_Pre,
                Sureness_Diff = Sureness_Post_1 - Sureness_Pre_1,
                
                ER1_Diff = ER1_Post - ER1_Pre,
                ER2_Diff = ER2_Post - ER2_Pre,
                ER_Diff = ER_Post - ER_Pre,)


psych::alpha(df_trim %>%
               dplyr::select(starts_with("ElecRigged")),na.rm = TRUE)

psych::alpha(df_trim %>%
               dplyr::select(matches("^ElecRigged_\\d.*Pre")),na.rm = TRUE)


summary(df_trim$ER_Pre)
hist(df_trim$ER_Pre)
summary(df_trim$ER_Post)
hist(df_trim$ER_Post)

summary(df_trim$ER0Norm_Pre)
#summary(df_trim$ER0Norm_Pre_center)  # pre centering now at end of "create dfs"
summary(df_trim$ER0Norm_Post_center)

summary(df_trim$ElecRigged_Pre_1)
summary(df_trim$ElecRigged_Post_1)

summary(df_trim$ElecRigged_1_Pre_1)
summary(df_trim$ElecRigged_2_Pre_1)

```

```{r alt dvs - period split}
#DVs for general views, 2024 views, 2020 views

df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  #means for each scale
                dplyr::rowwise() %>%
                 mutate(ER2020_Pre = mean(c(ER0Norm_Pre, (((ElecRigged_2_Pre_1-1)/4) * 100),(((ElecRigged_2_Pre_2-1)/4) * 100)), na.rm = TRUE),
                        ER2024_Pre = mean(c(ElecRigged_2_Pre_3), na.rm = TRUE),
                        ERGen_Pre = mean(c(ElecRigged_1_Pre_1,ElecRigged_1_Pre_2,ElecRigged_1_Pre_3), na.rm = TRUE),
                        
                        ER2020_Post = mean(c(ER0Norm_Post, (((ElecRigged_2_Post_1-1)/4) * 100),(((ElecRigged_2_Post_2-1)/4) * 100)), na.rm = TRUE),
                        ER2024_Post = mean(c(ElecRigged_2_Post_3), na.rm = TRUE),
                        ERGen_Post = mean(c(ElecRigged_1_Post_1,ElecRigged_1_Post_2,ElecRigged_1_Post_3), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  mutate(ER2020_Diff = ER2020_Post - ER2020_Pre,
         ER2024_Diff = ER2024_Post - ER2024_Pre,
         ERGen_Diff = ERGen_Post - ERGen_Pre,
         
         #perc change
         ER0_PercChange = (ER0Norm_Post - ER0Norm_Pre)/ER0Norm_Pre,
         Sureness_PercChange = if_else(Sureness_Pre_1 == 0, NA, (Sureness_Post_1 - Sureness_Pre_1) / Sureness_Pre_1),
         ER1_PercChange = (ER1_Post - ER1_Pre)/ER1_Pre,
         ER2_PercChange = (ER2_Post - ER2_Pre)/ER2_Pre,
         ER_PercChange = (ER_Post - ER_Pre)/ER_Pre,
         
         ER2020_PercChange = (ER2020_Post - ER2020_Pre)/ER2020_Pre,
         ER2024_PercChange = (ER2024_Post - ER2024_Pre)/ER2024_Pre,
         ERGen_PercChange = (ERGen_Post - ERGen_Pre)/ERGen_Pre)


table(df_trim$Sureness_Pre_1)

summary(df_trim$Sureness_PercChange)
```

```{r covariates}
  mutate(Cleaned_Year = str_replace_all(YearOfBirth, "[^0-9/-]", "")) %>%

    native1 = native & !race_multi,

    pacific1 = pacific & !race_multi,
    race_other1 = race_other & !race_multi)
```

```{r intention to treat vars}

#for participants who didn't complete survey, equates to 0
df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  mutate(ER0Norm_Post_itt = if_else(is.na(ER0Norm_Post),ER_Pre,ER0Norm_Post),
         Sureness_Post_1_itt = if_else(is.na(Sureness_Post_1),Sureness_Pre_1,Sureness_Post_1),
         ER1_Post_itt = if_else(is.na(ER1_Post),ER1_Pre,ER1_Post),
         ER2_Post_itt = if_else(is.na(ER2_Post),ER2_Pre,ER2_Post),
         
         ER_Post_itt = if_else(is.na(ER_Post),ER_Pre,ER_Post),
         ER2024_Post_itt = if_else(is.na(ER2024_Post),ER2024_Pre,ER2024_Post),
         ER2020_Post_itt = if_else(is.na(ER2020_Post),ER2020_Pre,ER2020_Post),
         AffPol_Post_itt = if_else(is.na(AffPol_Post),AffPol_Pre,AffPol_Post)) %>%

         ER1_Diff_itt = ER1_Post_itt - ER1_Pre,
         ER2_Diff_itt = ER2_Post_itt - ER2_Pre,
         
         ER_Diff_itt = ER_Post_itt - ER_Pre,
         AffPol_Diff_itt = AffPol_Post_itt - AffPol_Pre)
```

```{r values categorization - maybe drop}

# Define the categories and associated keywords
categories <- list(
  "Values and Ethics" = c("integrity", "honesty", "fairness", "responsibility", "ethics", "justice", "truth", "moral"),
  "Relationships and Community" = c("helping", "compassion", "care", "community", "support", "friendship", "love", "kindness"),
  "Health and Well-being" = c("health", "well-being", "balanced", "lifestyle", "Information-Tailored", "fitness", "mental", "happiness"),
  "Family and Personal Life" = c("family", "peace", "personal", "development", "supportive", "home", "parenting"),
  "Work and Productivity" = c("work", "dedication", "productivity", "goals", "achievement", "career", "success"),
  "Spirituality and Beliefs" = c("spiritual", "beliefs", "purpose", "meaning", "growth", "faith", "religion", "soul")
)

# Enhanced function to categorize a principle with primary and all matching categories
categorize_principle <- function(statement) {
  if (is.na(statement)) {
    return(list(PrimaryValuesCategory = "Uncategorized", ValuesCategory = "Uncategorized"))
  }
  
  statement <- tolower(statement)
  matched_categories <- c()
  primary_category <- NA
  
  # Match categories based on keywords
  for (category in names(categories)) {
    keywords <- categories[[category]]
    if (any(str_detect(statement, paste0("\\b", keywords, "\\b")))) {
      if (is.na(primary_category)) {
        primary_category <- category
      }
      matched_categories <- c(matched_categories, category)
    }
  }
  
  # Additional logic to better categorize previously uncategorized statements
  if (length(matched_categories) == 0) {
    if (str_detect(statement, "\\blove\\b|\\bfriends?\\b|\\bfamily\\b|\\bcaring\\b")) {
      return(list(PrimaryValuesCategory = "Relationships and Community", ValuesCategory = "Relationships and Community"))
    } else if (str_detect(statement, "\\bhappiness\\b|\\bjoy\\b|\\bwellness\\b|\\bhealth\\b")) {
      return(list(PrimaryValuesCategory = "Health and Well-being", ValuesCategory = "Health and Well-being"))
    } else if (str_detect(statement, "\\bhard work\\b|\\bsuccess\\b|\\bgoals?\\b")) {
      return(list(PrimaryValuesCategory = "Work and Productivity", ValuesCategory = "Work and Productivity"))
    } else if (str_detect(statement, "\\bfaith\\b|\\breligion\\b|\\bspiritual\\b|\\bsoul\\b")) {
      return(list(PrimaryValuesCategory = "Spirituality and Beliefs", ValuesCategory = "Spirituality and Beliefs"))
    } else {
      return(list(PrimaryValuesCategory = "Uncategorized", ValuesCategory = "Uncategorized"))
    }
  }
  
  return(list(PrimaryValuesCategory = primary_category, ValuesCategory = paste(matched_categories, collapse = ", ")))
}

# Apply categorization to both primary and all matching categories
df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(PrimaryValuesCategory = categorize_principle(WritingScreener)$PrimaryValuesCategory,
         ValuesCategory = categorize_principle(WritingScreener)$ValuesCategory) %>%
  ungroup()

# Ensure ValuesCategory is a character vector and not a list
df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  mutate(ValuesCategory = sapply(ValuesCategory, function(x) {
    if (is.list(x)) {
      paste(unlist(x), collapse = ", ")
    } else {
      as.character(x)
    }
  })) %>%
  mutate(ValuesCategory = as.character(ValuesCategory))


# Group by ValuesCategory and calculate the count and frequency
df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  group_by(ValuesCategory) %>%
  mutate(frequency = n()) %>%
  ungroup()
total_count <- nrow(df_trim)

df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  dplyr::mutate(PrimaryValuesCategory = if_else((frequency / total_count) < 0.02, "Other", ValuesCategory)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-frequency) 


table(df_trim$ValuesCategory)
```

```{r diff attrition indicators, warning=FALSE, paged.print=TRUE}
#preregistered
#1. Indicate some openness to 2020 election fraud through a single closed-ended election denialism question (operationalized as belief > 25 on a 0-100 scale) (er0) 
#2. Pass an attention check item embedded in the survey (nicks)
#3. Not show evidence of using automated responding or generative AI (evaluated via a prompt injection attack) (not allowed to paste)
#4. Complete the experiment in greater than 600 seconds. (duration) - including because of variation

  #pilot, s1 & 2 with test data dropped
df_trim <- df_trim %>%
    #exclusion criteria - testers, surveys taken in preview mode
  dplyr::filter(
    DistributionChannel != "preview",
    !(is.na(political_party))) #non-lucid/test participant (they all had pol party)


df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  mutate(Screened = if_else(Captcha != 15,"Captcha Failed",
                            if_else(screenquality < 2, "Low Values Quality", #screened out of study if screen quality <1
                                    if_else(DemRep_C < 4,"Non-Republican",
                                            if_else(nicks !=5,"Failed Nicks","Not Screened"))),missing = NA),
         
         Drop = if_else(ER0Norm_Pre <= 25,"Non-Election Denier", #preregistered excluding if belief > 25 on a 0-100 scale; compare to Sureness_Pre_1 < 50 since those from 25-50 have noisier effects; OR consider some other approach for outlier removal
                        if_else(screenquality < 2, "Low Values Quality", #adl exclusion based on values quality - not able to appropriately tailor based on values
                                if_else(Sureness_Pre_1 < 50, "CC >= 50",  
                                       #if_else(`Duration (in seconds)` <= 600,"Time Too Short", #speeder, (preregistered but ignoring this to account for diffs in convo length across conditions & this undermining causal inference)
                                       "Keep")), missing = NA), 
         
         DropAlt = if_else(ER0Norm_Pre <= 25,"Non-Election Denier", #used for main analysis
                        if_else(screenquality < 2, "Low Values Quality",
                               if_else(Sureness_Pre_1 < 25, "CC >= 25", 
                                       #if_else(`Duration (in seconds)` <= 600,"Time Too Short", 
                                       "Keep")), missing = NA), 

         NoComplete = if_else(Progress < 100, 1, 0)) %>%
  
  mutate(FinSample = if_else(Screened == "Not Screened" & Drop == "Keep" & Conspiracy == "Conspiracy",1,0,missing = NA),
         ScreenedDummy = if_else(Screened == "Not Screened", 0,1), #cross reference against actual var having response in the survey we want (look at if sureness_post is missing but they completed sureness_pre)
         AttritDurExp = case_when(is.na(Sureness_Pre_1) & is.na(Sureness_Post_1) ~ NA_integer_,
                                  !is.na(Sureness_Pre_1) & is.na(Sureness_Post_1) ~ 1L, TRUE ~ 0L), #answered pre but not post
         
         AttritDurExpS1.v2 = if_else(Progress >= 46 & Progress <=58 & Study == 1 & ConditionChat == "Chat", 1, #46-58%
                                  if_else(Progress >= 25 & Progress <=53 & Study == 1 & ConditionChat == "Qualtrics", 1,0),missing = NA), #25-53%
         AttritDurExpS2.v2 = if_else(Progress >= 49 & Progress <= 81 & Study == 2 & ConditionChat == "Chat", 1, 0, missing = NA)) #49-81%
```

```{r convo cleaning}
#remotes::install_github("hauselin/chatlogr")
#remotes::install_github("hauselin/chatlogr")
library(chatlogr)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Parse Study 1 chat participants
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
chatdata_s1 <- parse_users_chat_data(
  dat = df_trim %>%
    filter(Study == 1, ConditionChat == "Chat", !is.na(chathistory1)) %>%
    distinct(ResponseId, .keep_all = TRUE),
  idcol = "ResponseId",
  chat_col_patterns = c("chathistory"),
  join_str = '\"\"',     # Stitches long chats split across chathistory1 & 2
  nrows = Inf            # Process all rows without random sampling!
)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Parse Study 2 chat participants
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
chatdata_s2 <- parse_users_chat_data(
  dat = df_trim %>%
    filter(Study == 2, !is.na(chathistory1)) %>%
    distinct(ResponseId, .keep_all = TRUE),
  idcol = "ResponseId",
  chat_col_patterns = c("chathistory"),
  join_str = '\"\"',     # Stitches long chats split across chathistory1 & 2
  nrows = Inf            # Process all rows without random sampling!
)
# Combine successful parses
botchat <- bind_rows(chatdata_s1$df_success, chatdata_s2$df_success)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Number rounds sequentially and pivot wider
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
botchat <- botchat %>%
  filter(id != 0, role != "system", !is.na(content), nzchar(trimws(content))) %>%
  arrange(ResponseId, id, role) %>%
  mutate(role = if_else(role == "assistant", "GPTResponse",
                if_else(role == "user", "userResponse", role))) %>%
  group_by(ResponseId, role) %>%
  mutate(final_id = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unite("role_id", role, final_id, sep = "_", remove = FALSE)
botchat_wide <- botchat %>%
  select(ResponseId, role_id, content) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = role_id, values_from = content) %>%
  distinct(ResponseId, .keep_all = TRUE)
# Join chat dialogues back to main data
df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  dplyr::left_join(botchat_wide, by = "ResponseId", suffix = c("", ".chat"))
# ----------------------------------------------
# 4. Standardize rounds across Qualtrics & Chat
# ----------------------------------------------
df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Construct combined claim (Conspiracy_Solicitat + Elaboration)
    claim_combined = trimws(paste(coalesce(Conspiracy_Solicitat, ""), coalesce(Elaboration, ""))),
    
    # User Turns
    userResponse_1 = if_else(
      ConditionChat == "Chat",
      userResponse_1,
      if_else(!is.na(userResponse) & nzchar(userResponse), userResponse, claim_combined)
    ),
    userResponse_2 = if_else(ConditionChat == "Chat", userResponse_2, coalesce(userSecondResponse, Q5)),
    userResponse_3 = if_else(ConditionChat == "Chat", userResponse_3, coalesce(userThirdResponse, Q7)),
    userResponse_4 = if_else(ConditionChat == "Chat", userResponse_4, Q9), # <-- Q9 mapped here!
    
    # GPT Turns
    GPTResponse_1 = if_else(ConditionChat == "Chat", GPTResponse_1, GPTResponse),
    GPTResponse_2 = if_else(ConditionChat == "Chat", GPTResponse_2, GPTResponse2),
    GPTResponse_3 = if_else(ConditionChat == "Chat", GPTResponse_3, GPTResponse3),
    GPTResponse_4 = if_else(ConditionChat == "Chat", GPTResponse_4, NA_character_) # NA for Qualtrics
  )



df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  dplyr::left_join(botchat %>%
                     group_by(ResponseId) %>%
                     filter(createdAt == max(createdAt, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
                     ungroup() %>%
                     dplyr::select(ResponseId,createdAt), by = "ResponseId", suffix = c("", ".text"))

summary(df_trim$createdAt/60)


df_trim <- df_trim %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ConvoTime = if_else(ConditionChat == "Qualtrics",sum(c(`q1_timing_Page Submit`,`q2_timing_Page Submit`,`q3_timing_Page Submit`), na.rm = TRUE)/60,
                                    if_else(ConditionChat == "Chat",(createdAt)/60,NA_real_)))
```

```{r create dfs}
                    ERNorm_Pre_center = "ER_Pre", 
                    AffPol_Pre_center = "AffPol_Pre")
for (d in c("df_consp", "df_consp_2", "df_both")) {
  df <- get(d)
  for (nm in names(pre_center_map)) {
    x <- as.numeric(df[[pre_center_map[[nm]]]])
    df[[nm]] <- x - ave(x, df$Study, FUN = function(v) mean(v, na.rm = TRUE))
    Hmisc::label(df[[nm]]) <- Hmisc::label(df[[pre_center_map[[nm]]]])   # same label as the raw pre score
  }
  assign(d, df)
}

# z-score the pre, post and change scores with the mean and SD of the analytic sample (df_both, Studies 1 and 2 pooled), so a
# standardized coefficient is the effect in SDs of the analyzed participants. The same constants are applied to every df,
# so the preregistered-sample and full-sample models are on the same scale. Base R again, to keep df_both a rowwise_df.
std_vars <- c(dvs_post, dvs_pre, dvs_diff)
for (v in std_vars) {
  m <- mean(as.numeric(df_both[[v]]), na.rm = TRUE)
  s <- sd(as.numeric(df_both[[v]]), na.rm = TRUE)
  for (d in c("df_all", "df_trim", "df_trim_2", "df_consp", "df_consp_2", "df_both")) {
    df <- get(d)
    df[[paste0(v, "_std")]] <- (as.numeric(df[[v]]) - m) / s
    assign(d, df)
  }
}

df_all %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(c(dvs_pre, dvs_post,dvs_diff))) %>%
  psych::describe()
```

```{r deidentify for release}

# Drop quasi-identifiers before anything is written to data/. None of these columns is read by 02-09 or the Shiny app
# (StartDate, createdAt and YearOfBirth were only needed above, to assign Study, compute ConvoTime and compute Age).
# ResponseId (the Qualtrics response ID) is kept because the coded-conversation files and the Shiny app are keyed on it.
drop_for_release <- c("zip", "hhi", "region", "ethnicity",                                  # Lucid panel profile fields
                      "MetaInfo_Browser", "MetaInfo_Version", "MetaInfo_Operating System", "MetaInfo_Resolution", "Q2", # device metadata
                      "StartDate", "EndDate", "RecordedDate", "createdAt",                  # exact timestamps
                      "YearOfBirth", "Cleaned_Year",                                        # exact birth year (Age is kept)
                      "Comments", "alias_data")                                             # unstructured end-of-survey comments & typing JSON

for (d in c("df_consp", "df_consp_2", "df_both", "df_all", "df_trim", "df_trim_2")) {
  df <- get(d) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      -any_of(drop_for_release),
      -any_of(c(
        "screener3",
        "activeConditionNumber", "embedsystemMessage", "ChatbotPromptTemplate", "systemMessageTemplate",
        "PartyAffil_4_TEXT", "PartyReg_4_TEXT", "VoteMethod_4_TEXT", "Vote2024_Pre_2_TEXT",
        "Demog_14", "Demog_14.text", "Demog_14_11_TEXT", "Demog_14_11_TEXT.text",
        "education", "hispanic", "Hispanic", "Hispanic.text", "political_party",
        "EconomicConservatism.text", "SocialConservatism.text", "VoteFor2020.text",
        "principles", "MagicPill_5_TEXT",
        "userResponse_pt1", "userResponse_pt2", "userResponse",
        "userSecondResponse", "userThirdResponse",
        "GPTResponse", "GPTResponse2", "GPTResponse3",
        "userResponse_5", "GPTResponse_5",
        "ConditionChat_center", "Condition_center", "missing",
        "DemRep_C.text", "PartyAffil.text", "PartyReg.text", "VoteMethod.text",
        "UserLanguage", "Captcha", "nicks", "messageTypeOG", "Q_TerminateFlag", "model",
        "age", "gender", "Gender"
      )),
      -matches("^NewsSources.*\\.text$")
    )
  if (all(c("screener3_1", "screener3_9_TEXT") %in% names(df))) df <- df %>% dplyr::select(-c(screener3_1:screener3_9_TEXT))
  if (all(c("Q5", "chathistory4") %in% names(df))) df <- df %>% dplyr::select(-c(Q5:chathistory4))
  assign(d, df)
}

# Apply free-text PII redactions (masking identified spans with [REDACTED])
rules_path <- here::here("scripts", "redaction_rules.csv")
if (file.exists(rules_path)) {
  rules <- read.csv(rules_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (d in c("df_consp", "df_consp_2", "df_both", "df_all", "df_trim", "df_trim_2")) {
    df <- get(d)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(rules))) {
      id  <- rules$id[i]
      col <- rules$col[i]
      old <- rules$old_pattern[i]
      rep <- rules$replacement[i]
      if (col %in% names(df)) {
        match_idx <- which(df$ResponseId == id)
        if (length(match_idx) > 0) {
          val <- df[[col]][match_idx]
          if (!is.na(val) && grepl(old, val, fixed = TRUE)) {
            df[[col]][match_idx] <- gsub(old, rep, val, fixed = TRUE)
          }
        }
      }
    }
    assign(d, df)
  }
}
```
